q244407.placeNote: Born, it is believed, on the farm Bulhoek near Steynsburg (the pin). His memoirs name Vaalbank, near Colesberg, and some say Soutpansdrift; the family had no fixed home.

cur-fossil-kirkwood.dateNote: In 1845 William Atherstone and Andrew Geddes Bain found bones near Dassieklip in the Bushmans River valley, Eastern Cape: the first dinosaur found in Africa, later named Paranthodon. The rock is about 139–131 million years old (Early Cretaceous). Wikidata pins the formation at a rounded point.
cur-fossil-kirkwood.summary: Where the first dinosaur in Africa, the plated Paranthodon, was found in 1845.

q440490.placeNote: Born in Qutubeni village, Engcobo district; the pin is the town of Ngcobo.

q214473.born: 18 December 1946, Tarkastad, Cape Province, South Africa

cur-fossil-klasies.dateNote: Ronald Singer and John Wymer dug these sea caves in 1967–68 and found human bones up to about 110,000 years old (0.11 million years), some of the oldest Homo sapiens remains in southern Africa.
cur-fossil-klasies.summary: Sea caves in South Africa holding some of the oldest remains of our own species in southern Africa.
